description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Document AI, the standalone API that extracts the fields you define from any document (PDF or image). Use when the user wants to read custom data from proof of funds, bank statements, payslips, tax documents, invoices, contracts or source-of-wealth letters; get typed values (text, number, date) for their own field list; compare the name on a document with an expected person or company; detect tampered or edited PDFs and images; decode QR codes and barcodes on a document; or add a DOCUMENT_AI step to a verification workflow using Didit. Synchronous, multipart upload.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
